title: Vader tests Hulkamania
summary: Vader challenges Hogan with a level of power few opponents can match. Flair’s involvement keeps their championship conflict tangled in outside interference.

chapters.title: Flair prevents a clear championship finish
chapters.result: Hogan retains against Vader by disqualification.
chapters.context: Flair’s interference denies the match a decisive in-ring resolution.

chapters.title: The strap match ends around Flair
chapters.result: Hogan is declared the winner of the strap match against Vader.
chapters.context: Hogan touches the corners while dragging the interfering Flair, an unusual finish that avoids a straightforward victory over Vader.
